Oneliner

Test an ADS-B receiver that aims to track aircraft in flight.
Description

Test an ADS-B receiver that aims to track aircraft in flight. The mission is to characterise a small SDR payload and a patch antenna for receiving ADS-B signals in the 1090MHz band.
Notes

Selected by ESA Fly Your Satellite 2017.
